subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible chat history, and through which supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the implementation depends on maintainer intent for third-party persistence ownership, direct SQLite coupling versus API/plugin integration, opt-in configuration, and backfill behavior.

options.title: Design opt-in sync
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with explicit configuration, schema/version handling, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Move to plugin boundary
options.body: Require the Open WebUI-specific mirror to live behind a plugin or adapter boundary, adding only any missing core API seam.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Control UI sends do not update Open WebUI visible history.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in sync
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with explicit configuration, schema/version handling, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits at the Gateway chat/session persistence and Open WebUI integration boundary where steipete has recent related history.
